Now that the smoke has mostly cleared from Canada’s wildfires, let’s try to clear some of the bogus smoke ABOUT Canada’s wildfires, particularly Trump’s fossil-fuel-friendly denial that climate change has anything to do with it.

Irking Canadians more is that the U.S. is responsible for more greenhouse gases in the atmosphere than any other country, so we come to this stupid allegation with unclean hands on the real underlying cause of worsening wildfires.

Last thought: flood- and wildfire-prone regions of the U.S. are already seeing the Great Climate Insurance Collapse hitting homeowners. This isn’t just some far North wilderness problem; for many Americans, it’s the affordability and value of their homes.
